slides.title: Date = [[time machine]]
points: Orders kab aaye, joining kab hui
Har report mein date ka khel 📊

slides.title: Saal [[nikalo]]
slides.code:
SELECT order_id, order_date,
  YEAR(order_date) AS yr
FROM orders
WHERE order_date
  >= '2025-01-01';
slides.note: PostgreSQL mein YEAR() nahi: **EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)**

slides.title: [[Result]] aisa
slides.note: 2024 wale orders WHERE ne **pehle hi** bahar kar diye ✂️

slides.title: Farq naapo: [[DATEDIFF]]
slides.note: Delivery mein kitne din lage? Bas yahi formula 🚚

slides.why: Text jaisa format = galat comparison. **YYYY-MM-DD** hi safe hai 📅
